intent.text: Let the signers below sign for {Account|address} together, once their weights reach {SignerQuorum}.

risks.message: {SignerEntries.*.SignerEntry.Account|address} will be able to sign for this account together, including sending all of its funds. Only continue if you hold enough of these keys to reach a weight of {SignerQuorum}.
The current signer list will no longer be able to sign for this account.
